name: What are the design considerations for an ADU or garage conversion to maximize space and functionality?

mainEntity.name: What are the design considerations for an ADU or garage conversion to maximize space and functionality?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maximizing space and functionality in an ADU or garage conversion involves thoughtful design. Consider multi-functional furniture, built-in storage solutions, and efficient layouts for kitchens and bathrooms. High ceilings and ample natural light can make smaller spaces feel larger. Strategic window placement, open-concept living areas, and careful material selection also contribute to a comfortable and practical living environment. Our design team focuses on creating efficient and aesthetically pleasing spaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Design considerations include multi-functional furniture, built-in storage, efficient layouts, and maximizing natural light to enhance both space and functionality.
